name: Haunted Places
description: Haunted places are locations across the world where paranormal activity — apparitions, unexplained sounds, sensations, or anomalies — is repeatedly reported by independent witnesses over time. They are studied as a form of ghostlore (a sub-genre of folklore) and underpin a substantial global ghost-tourism industry.
origin: Global. Wikipedia's List of reportedly haunted locations covers more than 47 countries across every inhabited continent.
